correctness.rationale: The normal form of stylic elements is nested strictly increasing N-tableau rows with strictly increasing row minima; generator occurrence iff moved point, so R1=S. Entries in higher rows may only be starts of maximal consecutive support runs, for otherwise their earlier occurrence and a bottom-row predecessor give a double decrement, contradicting one-step image. Conversely upper entries only at run starts cannot cause a double decrement; d1 cannot enter R2 by minimum order. Heights of the b run-start letters with h1=1 are exactly restricted-growth strings, bijective with set partitions, with maximal height equal to number of blocks/rows. Counting support runs via 2b gap endpoints gives binom(n+1,2b), and nonadjacent supports give idempotents. Independent enumeration of ALL N-tableaux through n=8, including 21147 distinct n=8 tableaux, evaluated the quotient by raw generator compositions and matched every fiber and row count. Universality follows from the structural bijection, not enumeration.

final_claim: For any one-step order-preserving decreasing Catalan map α_S defined by downward shifts on support S⊆[n], the stylic quotient fiber is canonically parametrized by partitions of the b maximal support runs. Exactly Stirling(b,h) preimages have h-row N-tableaux, total Bell(b), and binom(n+1,2b) one-step maps have b runs; idempotent supports are precisely nonconsecutive subsets.
limitations: Special family consists of one-step transformations; total Stylic_n fiber distribution not characterized.
The choice of a canonical restricted-growth labeling of partitions is logically part of the claimed bijection.
